lines.en: label kirinspecial45p1:
scene noonsky
And so another day of actually working hard at the job I actually care about comes to an end.
lines.zh: 于是，又一天在我真正在乎的工作上真正卖力的日子结束了。

lines.en: I say that almost unironically, as I actually {i}did{/i} contribute in some form to the greater good after the last bell rang today.
lines.zh: 我这么说几乎不带反讽，因为今天放学后我{i}确实{/i}以某种形式为更大的善做出了贡献。

lines.en: With Imani and Makoto busy at swim club and the club that I'm meant to advise being mostly fine without any form of supervision, there was no one left to grade the papers my subordinates assigned but me.
lines.zh: Imani 和 Makoto 忙着游泳部，而我本该去顾问的那个社团没人看着也基本没事，于是下属们布置的卷子就只剩下我来批了。

lines.en: Needless to say, everyone received an A+ regardless of whether or not they deserved one and now my wrist hurts from having to write and circle that twenty times.
lines.zh: 不用说，不管配不配，每个人都拿了 A+，而我现在手腕因为写了二十遍、圈了二十遍而酸痛。

lines.en: So, what better place to go from here than a location where everyone {i}else’s{/i} wrists hurt as well?
lines.zh: 那么，接下来还有什么地方比一个{i}别人{/i}手腕也酸的地方更合适呢？

lines.en: scene kirinarcade1
See: the archery range. Or, as I like to refer to it — probably the only club that actually does club stuff instead of just fucking around.
lines.zh: 瞧：射箭场。或者按我的说法——大概是唯一一个真的在搞社团活动、而不是只顾着瞎混的社团。

lines.en: You’ll have to peer past the soul (and cock)-sucking entity in front of you to see it, but I can assure you it is there.
lines.zh: 你得越过挡在你面前那个吸魂（和吸鸡巴）的生物才能看见它，但我向你保证它就在那儿。

lines.en: And that it is filled with girls who are unintentionally training themselves to become better at giving me handjobs one day.
lines.zh: 而且里面全是些无意间在训练自己，好让将来更擅长给我打手枪的女生。

lines.en: : Hey. You haven’t gone home already?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你还没回家啊？

lines.en: : The one speaking to me now is already good at giving handjobs. But I’m looking forward to seeing how much she improves as the days go by.
lines.zh: : 现在跟我说话的这位，打手枪已经很熟练了。不过我挺期待看她随着日子推移能进步多少。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade2
: Thanks! Though, I think you might have accidentally said that out loud instead of keeping it to yourself.
lines.zh: : 谢谢！不过，我觉得你可能不小心说出声了，而不是憋在心里。

lines.en: : No, I just knew there wasn’t a need to keep it inside anymore as having my innermost thoughts heard by you won’t really change the way either one of us thinks.
lines.zh: : 不，我只是知道没必要再憋着了，因为让你听到我最心底的想法，并不会真的改变我们任何一个人的想法。

lines.en: : That’s fair. And if it gets you to say nice things about me more often, I’m totally cool with it.
lines.zh: : 有道理。而且如果这能让你更常说我好话，我完全没意见。

lines.en: : What are you doing over here? You know Miss Watabe doesn’t like you interrupting practice.
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干嘛？你知道 Watabe 老师不喜欢你打扰练习。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure she doesn’t like you leaving in the middle of it either. It looks like everyone else is still out there.
lines.zh: : 我敢说她也不喜欢你练到一半开溜。看起来其他人都还在外面。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade3
: Yeah...I’m kind of bailing while she’s not paying attention to me. I wasn’t feeling it today.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我有点趁她没注意我的时候溜了。今天没状态。

lines.en: : Don’t tell me you’re already giving up on {i}this{/i} club too?
lines.zh: : 别告诉我你连{i}这个{/i}社团也要放弃了？

lines.en: scene kirinarcade4
: I’m not “giving up.” My relationship with kyudo is totally different from my relationship with soccer since this is something I actually chose and didn’t just...get sucked into.
lines.zh: : 我不是“放弃”。我和弓道的关系跟我和足球的关系完全不同，因为这是我真正自己选的，不是……被卷进去的。

lines.en: : Why leave then? What aren’t you {i}feeling?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那为什么要走？你{i}没状态{/i}什么？

lines.en: scene kirinarcade5
: Uhh...good enough, I guess?
lines.zh: : 呃……够好了吧，大概？

lines.en: : So it’s the same thing as soccer, just in a slightly different way.
lines.zh: : 那就是跟足球一回事，只是方式稍微不同。

lines.en: : It’s still different. This is just me getting in my own head.
lines.zh: : 还是不一样。这只是我自己钻牛角尖。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade6
: That’s the thing with kyudo, though. It’s like 80%% mental and 20%% physical. Even super old people can be really good at it since the mechanics aren’t that demanding.
lines.zh: : 可弓道就是这么回事。大概 80%% 靠心理，20%% 靠身体。连很老的人都能玩得很好，因为动作本身要求不高。

lines.en: : So basically, you’re even more screwed than you were in soccer.
lines.zh: : 所以基本上，你比踢足球时更完蛋了。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade7
: Nuh-uh. Why would I be screwed? All I have to do is just convince myself I’m better than I actually am and I’ve been doing that in pretty much every area of my life for as long as I’ve been alive.
lines.zh: : 才不是。我怎么会完蛋？我只要说服自己我比实际更强就行了，而我有生以来在生活的几乎每个领域都是这么干的。

lines.en: : Like how you still won’t admit you’re actually in love with me.
lines.zh: : 就像你到现在也不肯承认你其实爱上了我。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade8
: Exactly! See? You get it.
lines.zh: : 正是！看吧？你懂的。

lines.en: : Cool, so I’ll just take that as your admission and we can move onto dating for real.
lines.zh: : 好，那我就当这是你的承认了，我们可以直接正式交往了。

lines.en: : Cool! Sounds good.
lines.zh: : 好啊！听起来不错。

lines.en: : That was a joke, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 那是开玩笑，Kirin。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade9
: So was mine. I don’t actually love you. I just want you to {i}think{/i} I love you since holding your hand the other night felt kind of nice.
lines.zh: : 我的也是。我其实不爱你。我只是想让你{i}以为{/i}我爱你，因为那天晚上牵你的手感觉还挺不错的。

lines.en: : Also, Karin saw us kiss. Whoops.
lines.zh: : 还有，Karin 看到我们接吻了。哎呀。

lines.en: : Wait...she did?
lines.zh: : 等等……她真的看到了？

lines.en: : No. I just wanted to see what kind of face you’d make. And judging by the one I got, I think it’s safe to say you want to fuck my sister.
lines.zh: : 没有。我只是想看看你会露出什么表情。从你现在的反应来看，我想可以肯定地说你想睡我姐姐。

lines.en: : I think it’s safe to say you already knew I wanted to fuck your sister.
lines.zh: : 我想可以肯定地说，你早就知道我想睡你姐姐。

lines.en: : Yeah, but now I {i}really{/i} know.
lines.zh: : 是啊，但现在我{i}真的{/i}知道了。

lines.en: : What’s getting into you, Kirin? I’m not going to stop you from leaving, but I’d at least like to know what’s going on.
lines.zh: : 你怎么了，Kirin？我不会拦着你走，但我至少想知道发生了什么。

lines.en: : Kind of like how I would have liked to know what was going on while you were fingering Miku?
lines.zh: : 就像我那时候也希望知道你在用手指弄 Miku 的时候发生了什么一样？

lines.en: : Exactly like that. You are being given an opportunity right now to prove how much better than me you are at something. And that’s like, your whole thing.
lines.zh: : 一模一样。现在你正被给了一个机会，来证明你在某件事上比我强多少。而这基本上就是你一贯的作风。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade10
: Hah...fine.
lines.zh: : 哈……好吧。

lines.en: : It’s Uta. She’s too good already.
lines.zh: : 是 Uta。她已经太强了。

lines.en: : I thought joining a club like this would be the best way to sort of...get ahead of everybody else. I thought I’d finally get to be the good one if I put in the work.
lines.zh: : 我还以为加入这种社团是……某种抢在其他人前面的最好办法。我以为只要肯下功夫，我终于能当那个厉害的人。

lines.en: : Last thing I expected was for someone to have experience already. It’s fucking kyudo, not soccer.
lines.zh: : 我万万没想到会有人已经有经验了。这他妈可是弓道，又不是足球。

lines.en: : I swear, it’s like every single club has some sort of prodigy in it.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，好像每一个社团里都藏着个什么天才。

lines.en: : Not the swim club. They-
lines.zh: : 游泳部没有。她们——

lines.en: : Karin’s in the swim club.
lines.zh: : Karin 在游泳部。

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦。对哦。

lines.en: : Well, Karin’s just good at everything, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯，Karin 反正什么都擅长，所以……

lines.en: : Yeah...you don’t have to remind me.
lines.zh: : 是啊……你不用提醒我。

lines.en: : That’s really all it is, though. I was gonna go home and watch some videos to study that way, but...
lines.zh: : 不过真的就只是这样。我本来打算回家看些视频自学的，但是……

lines.en: scene kirinarcade11
: Do you maybe wanna...hang out for a little while instead?
lines.zh: : 你要不要……出去玩一会儿？

lines.en: : Like...in a...{i}non-{/i}sexual way or...something?...
lines.zh: : 就是……以{i}非{/i}性的方式……之类的？……

lines.en: : Let me feel your forehead. I think you’re sick.
lines.zh: : 让我摸摸你的额头。我觉得你病了。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade12
: It’s not like that! We just...don’t {i}always{/i} have to do that stuff, you know?!
lines.zh: : 才不是那样！我们只是……{i}不必每次{/i}都做那种事吧，你知道吗？！

lines.en: : How hard is it for you to say all of this right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在说出这些有多难？

lines.en: : You have no fucking idea. But I’m serious. Let’s, like...go bowling. Or...go to the arcade or something. Anywhere with air conditioning is fine, really. I just don’t want to be outside.
lines.zh: : 你他妈根本想象不到。但我是认真的。我们，那个……去打保龄球吧。或者……去游戏厅什么的。真的，只要有空调的地方都行。我就是不想待在室外。

lines.en: : Don’t you have other friends for stuff like that? I’m the sex guy, remember? That’s the whole point of our relationship.
lines.zh: : 这种事你不是有别的朋友吗？我是那个性对象，记得吗？那才是我们关系的全部意义。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade13
: Oh...yeah. I guess I could...call Noriko or-
lines.zh: : 哦……对。我想我可以……打电话给 Noriko 或者——

lines.en: : Kirin, I’m joking.
lines.zh: : Kirin，我在开玩笑。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade14
: You are?!
lines.zh: : 真的吗？！

lines.en: scene kirinarcade15
: I mean...uhh...you are?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……呃……真的吗？

lines.en: : Were those just stars-
lines.zh: : 刚才那些是星星吗——

lines.en: : No. Anyway, arcade? Let’s go to the arcade. I like the arcade.
lines.zh: : 不是。总之，游戏厅？我们去游戏厅吧。我喜欢游戏厅。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade16
: The arcade is really cool. It’s a place where all kinds of people who aren’t even dating go to hang out.
lines.zh: : 游戏厅超棒的。那是个各种根本没在交往的人也会去玩的地方。

lines.en: : Which doesn’t mean that people who {i}are{/i} dating aren’t allowed there, but- hey. What are you just standing there for? We’re going to the arcade.
lines.zh: : 这也不是说{i}在{/i}交往的人就不许去，不过——嘿。你站着干嘛？我们要去游戏厅了。

lines.en: : You’re really funny when you try to act like a normal girl, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 你努力装成普通女生的时候真是有够好笑的，Kirin。

lines.en: : I’m...plenty normal when I want to be! It’s your fault you’re only just seeing that now!
lines.zh: : 我……想正常的时候可正常了！你现在才看出来是你的问题！

lines.en: scene black
Thanks to the location of the archery range being a bit of a walk from the main building and clubs still ongoing, we manage to make it off of school grounds without bumping into anyone else.
lines.zh: 多亏射箭场离主楼有一段路，而且社团活动还在进行，我们成功溜出了校园，没撞见任何人。

lines.en: Well, anyone else we {i}know{/i} at least. There are plenty of other girls who see us together and, while Kirin pretends to know who some of them are, I’m almost certain it’s a bluff.
lines.zh: 至少没撞见任何我们{i}认识{/i}的人。有不少别的女生看到我们走在一起，虽然 Kirin 装作认识其中一些，但我几乎可以肯定那是虚张声势。

lines.en: It’s pretty clear at this point that she doesn’t have any friends outside of the class and, if she does, I’m sure it’s all on a superficial basis.
lines.zh: 到这一步已经很明显了，她在班上以外没有任何朋友，就算有，我也敢说全是些表面交情。

lines.en: Plus, I’m not too worried about what anyone will think at this point since I leave school with Ami and the others all the time and no one’s said anything yet.
lines.zh: 再说，我现在也不太担心别人会怎么想，因为我经常和 Ami 她们一起离开学校，至今也没人说过什么。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade17
There’s also the fact that arcades are {i}full{/i} of teenagers after school lets out, and it was obvious from the get-go that we’d be trying to blend in with them.
lines.zh: 还有一点，放学后游戏厅里{i}全是{/i}青少年，从一开始就很明显，我们得尽量混进他们中间。

lines.en: After Kirin drops her stuff off in a nearby coin-locker, we make our way into a small, unfamiliar arcade that is, expectedly, filled with other girls from the school.
lines.zh: Kirin 把东西塞进附近的投币储物柜后，我们走进一家不怎么熟悉的小游戏厅，不出所料，里面全是学校里的其他女生。

lines.en: Some of them look at me, probably because I have a penis, but it’s never for more than a few seconds before they carry on with their business.
lines.zh: 有些人看我，大概因为我有鸡巴，但从来不会超过几秒，之后她们就继续忙自己的了。

lines.en: Meanwhile, Kirin spends at least 2,000 yen trying to pull a blue turtle out of a glass box.
lines.zh: 与此同时，Kirin 花了至少 2000 日元，试图从一个玻璃箱里夹出一只蓝色的乌龟。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade18
: Fuck!
: Wow, Kirin. This sure is fun.
lines.zh: : 哇，Kirin。这可真好玩。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade19

: For your information, it wasn’t my intention to repeatedly fail. I’m normally pretty good at these types of games. But at this point, Sensei, I have a vendetta and we can not leave until the Squirtle is mine.
lines.zh: : 跟你说清楚，我可不是故意一直失败的。这种游戏我平时挺擅长的。但事到如今，老师，我跟它杠上了，在把那只 Squirtle 拿到手之前我们绝不能走。

lines.en: : That is not a good name for whatever that thing is.
lines.zh: : 那玩意儿叫这名字可不太妙。

lines.en: : You know what fucking Pokemon are. Stop pretending you were born in like...the mid-Showa period. It’s weird and you’re cool enough without acting all oblivious and shit.
lines.zh: : 你明明知道他妈的宝可梦是什么。别装得好像你出生在什么……昭和中期似的。这很怪，而且你本来就已经够酷了，不用装成什么都不知道的样子。

lines.en: : No one can ever be cool {i}enough,{/i} Kirin. But thank you for acknowledging my mysterious air of...mystery.
lines.zh: : 没有人能酷到{i}极致{/i}，Kirin。不过谢谢你认可我这股……神秘的气质。

lines.en: : Stop cherry-picking the good things out of my insults and just help me already.
lines.zh: : 别老从我的骂人话里挑好听的，快过来帮忙。

lines.en: : How? Do you want me to turn this into a scene from a rom-com and grip the joystick with you? Move in for a kiss as we pull a weird blue turtle out of a machine?
lines.zh: : 怎么帮？你想让我把这变成爱情喜剧里的一幕，跟你一起握着摇杆？在我们把一只奇怪的蓝乌龟从机器里拽出来的时候凑过去亲你？

lines.en: scene kirinarcade20
: What kind of rom-coms are {i}you{/i} watching?
lines.zh: : 你{i}到底{/i}在看什么爱情喜剧啊？

lines.en: : None. I’ve already made it apparent today that I’m too cool for them.
lines.zh: : 一部都没看。我今天已经表现得很清楚了，我太酷了，看不上那些。

lines.en: : I just wanted you to stand on the other side of the machine and check my angles, not {i}kiss{/i} me in front of like, twenty other girls.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你站到机器另一边帮我看角度，不是要当着大概二十个女生的面{i}亲{/i}我。

lines.en: : You want to do that, go for it. It’s your death sentence. Not like I have anything to lose from kissing a teacher.
lines.zh: : 你想亲就去亲。那是你自己找死。反正亲一个老师我又不会有什么损失。

lines.en: : Except, you know, the respect of your classmates and whatever sort of reputation you’ve built for yourself.
lines.zh: : 除了，你知道的，同学们的尊重，还有你给自己攒下的那点名声。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade21
: Woo boy. Reputation and respect. Yippee.
lines.zh: : 哦哟。名声和尊重。好耶。

lines.en: : You want to know what my reputation is, Sensei? It’s “Karin’s sister.” If anything, making out with a teacher in broad daylight would help put me on the map.
lines.zh: : 你想知道我的名声是什么吗，老师？是“Karin 的妹妹”。说真的，光天化日之下跟老师接吻，反而能让我出名。

lines.en: : It would help put {i}me{/i} in jail.
lines.zh: : 那会让我{i}进监狱{/i}。

lines.en: : As long as I get my Squirtle, I don’t really care.
lines.zh: : 只要我能拿到我的 Squirtle，我不在乎。

lines.en: : You’d have much more success in that regard if we were in my bedroom.
lines.zh: : 这种事要是在我卧室里，成功率会高得多。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade22
: Was that...supposed to be a squirting joke? I don't even do that.
lines.zh: : 那是……想开一个“潮吹”的玩笑吗？我根本不会那样。

lines.en: : Cool joke though, right?
lines.zh: : 不过玩笑挺妙的，对吧？

lines.en: scene kirinarcade23
: Yeah, Sensei. Super-
lines.zh: : 是啊，老师。超——

lines.en: scene kirinarcade24
: FUCK!
: Kirin? Is that you?
lines.zh: : Kirin？是你吗？

lines.en: scene kirinarcade25
: Heh?
scene black
scene kirinarcade26
: What happened? Aren’t you supposed to be at archery club?
lines.zh: : 怎么回事？你不是该在弓道社吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...aren’t {i}you{/i} supposed to be at swim club?
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}你{/i}不是该在游泳部吗？

lines.en: : It was cancelled after Ayane accidentally killed the janitor. We have the rest of the day off now.
lines.zh: : Ayane 不小心把校工弄死了，所以取消了。我们现在放假了。

lines.en: : How does she keep doing that and why isn’t anyone suspicious of it?
lines.zh: : 她到底是怎么一直做到这种事的，而且为什么没人怀疑？

lines.en: if karinlied == True:
scene kirinarcade27
: Ah! Sensei! Hi! I’m Karin! It’s nice to meet you!
lines.zh: : 啊！老师！你好！我是 Karin！很高兴认识你！

lines.en: : Again!
lines.zh: : 又来了！

lines.en: : Kirin, take over. I messed up.
lines.zh: : Kirin，你接手。我搞砸了。

lines.en: : How are you still this nervous around him? Haven’t you two, like, literally gone on a date together?
lines.zh: : 你怎么在他面前还是这么紧张？你们两个不是，那个……真的约会过了吗？

lines.en: : She wasn’t much better during that.
lines.zh: : 那次她也好不到哪儿去。

lines.en: : She {i}was{/i} adorable, though. But Karin is always adorable, so-
lines.zh: : 不过她{i}很{/i}可爱。可 Karin 本来就一直很可爱，所以——

lines.en: scene kirinarcade28
: And down she goes.
lines.zh: : 然后她就倒下了。

lines.en: : I’m okay! Don’t mind me!
lines.zh: : 我没事！别管我！

lines.en: : Yeah, I had a feeling that was going to happen.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我就知道会这样。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade29
: Haha! Floors! Am I right?!
lines.zh: : 哈哈！地板！对吧？！

lines.en: : You need, like...serious, psychiatric help.
lines.zh: : 你需要，那个……严重的精神科帮助。

lines.en: else:
scene kirinarcade30
: Oh...Sensei...
: You’re here too...
lines.zh: : 你也在啊……

lines.en: : What’s up with that reaction?
lines.zh: : 你这反应是怎么回事？

lines.en: : What reaction? I’m just...happy you two are...
lines.zh: : 什么反应？我只是……很高兴你们两个……

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene kirinarcade31
: A-Anyway! Is everything...you know...working out over there? In your new club?
lines.zh: : 总……总之！那边……那个……还顺利吗？在你的新社团？

lines.en: : Because it’s a little lonely not having you around anymore and...if you ever want to maybe, like...spend more time together...
lines.zh: : 因为你不在了有点寂寞，而且……如果你什么时候想，那个……多待在一起的话……

lines.en: : Things are fine. I’m just taking a little time off. I’ve been there way more than the other girls lately and Miss Watabe said I should rest my wrist for a little while so I don’t mess it up.
lines.zh: : 一切都好。我只是休息一下。最近我去得比其他女生多太多了，Watabe 老师说让我把手腕休息一阵，别搞坏了。

lines.en: Kirin lied as naturally as she breathed.
lines.zh: Kirin 撒起谎来跟呼吸一样自然。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade32
: Really?! That’s great!
lines.zh: : 真的吗？！那太好了！

lines.en: scene kirinarcade33
: I was so worried you wouldn’t fit in there since you’ve always been with Miku and me. But to hear that everything is going well is-
lines.zh: : 我好担心你在那边融不进去，因为你一直都是跟 Miku 和我混在一起的。但听说一切顺利，我就——

lines.en: : Yup. All good. Don’t need to be checked up on. Thanks, Sis.
lines.zh: : 嗯。一切都好。不用老来查岗。谢了，老姐。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade34
: Okay...well, I...made plans with a friend, so...I’ll leave you alone now.
lines.zh: : 好……那个，我……跟朋友约好了，所以……我就不打扰你们了。

lines.en: : Are you coming home for dinner? You don’t have to if you don’t want to, it’s just...it’s my turn and...I want to...know how much to make...
lines.zh: : 你回家吃晚饭吗？你不想回来也没关系，只是……轮到我了，而且……我想知道……要做多少……

lines.en: : Uhhh, not sure. You can make some for me and I’ll just reheat it if I swing by later.
lines.zh: : 呃，不确定。你可以给我做一份，我晚点要是顺路回去就热一下。

lines.en: : Okay...
: Guess I’ll just...see you later then.
lines.zh: : 那我就……回头见吧。

lines.en: : Yup. See you.
lines.zh: : 嗯。回头见。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade35
Karin leaves without saying goodbye to me, but I’m not about to berate her for it when Kirin, as always, is basically the one who {i}forced{/i} her away.
lines.zh: Karin 连再见都没跟我说就走了，但我也不会为此数落她，因为一如既往，基本是 Kirin {i}逼{/i}她走的。

lines.en: : Why not go hang out with her instead?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不跟她去玩？

lines.en: scene kirinarcade36
: Because {i}we’re{/i} hanging out. She said she made plans with a friend anyway. I’d just be getting in the way.
lines.zh: : 因为{i}我们{/i}在玩啊。她说她跟朋友约好了。我要是跟着只会碍事。

lines.en: : I think Karin would be more than happy to have you tag along.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Karin 会非常乐意让你一起去。

lines.en: : That’s nice. But it doesn’t change the fact that I’d rather be with you.
lines.zh: : 那是挺好的。但这改变不了我更想跟你在一起的事实。

lines.en: : Why though? You can be with me whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 为什么？你想跟我什么时候在一起都行啊。

lines.en: : No. I can be with {i}Karin{/i} whenever I want. Getting to spend time with you after school is like winning the lottery. Obviously I’m gonna cash in.
lines.zh: : 不。我什么时候想跟{i}Karin{/i}在一起都行。放学后能跟你待在一起就像中了彩票。我当然要去兑现。

lines.en: : Karin could be, like...delivering a baby or pulling a cat out of a tree and she’d immediately stop doing either of those things if I asked her to come hang out with me.
lines.zh: : Karin 就算正在……接生，或者正把猫从树上救下来，只要我叫她来陪我，她都会立刻停下手里的事。

lines.en: : Actually, she’d probably finish them first because she’s Karin and she’s fucking perfect and good at everything and wholesome and everyone likes her.
lines.zh: : 其实她大概会先把事情做完，因为她是 Karin，她他妈的完美、什么都擅长、又阳光，人人都喜欢她。

lines.en: : But, my inferiority complex aside, I can’t do that with you. Your time is spread too thin between all of the other girls who want your fat dick inside of them.
lines.zh: : 不过，撇开我的自卑情结不谈，我可没法对你那么做。你的时间被所有其他想把你那根大鸡巴塞进自己身体里的女生摊得太薄了。

lines.en: : Which isn’t to say that’s {i}all{/i} I want, of course. It’s just...
lines.zh: : 当然，我并不是说那{i}就{/i}是我想要的全部。只是……

lines.en: scene kirinarcade37
: Well, you said it yourself the other night.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那天晚上你自己说过的。

lines.en: : “I’m not enough for you.”
lines.zh: : “我对你来说不够。”

lines.en: : So, like...it got me thinking...how do I {i}become{/i} enough?
lines.zh: : 所以，那个……这让我开始想……我该怎么{i}变成{/i}够？

lines.en: : It’s gotta be this, right? Spending time together and seeing if we’re compatible in ways where we keep our clothes on instead of just resorting to sex.
lines.zh: : 肯定就是这个吧？多待在一起，看看我们在穿着衣服的方面合不合得来，而不是一上来就靠做爱解决。

lines.en: : Kirin, are you {i}growing?{/i}
lines.zh: : Kirin，你是在{i}成长{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene kirinarcade38
: Am I? I thought I stopped.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我以为我已经停止发育了。

lines.en: : No, as a person.
lines.zh: : 不是，我是说作为一个人。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade39
: Oh. Maybe. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 哦。也许吧。我不知道。

lines.en: : I’m trying not to think too much about it because that’s the same exact problem I’m having with kyudo.
lines.zh: : 我尽量不去想太多，因为那跟我在弓道上遇到的问题一模一样。

lines.en: : I just want to hold your hand more.
lines.zh: : 我只是想多牵牵你的手。

lines.en: : And the thought of other girls holding your hand is starting to piss me off.
lines.zh: : 而且一想到别的女生牵你的手，我就开始来气。

lines.en: : But...the thought of me fucking them, isn’t?
lines.zh: : 但……一想到我跟她们上床，却不会？

lines.en: : Weirdly enough, the hand thing pisses me off more.
lines.zh: : 说也奇怪，牵手这事更让我生气。

lines.en: : They both kinda suck, though. But until I’m-
lines.zh: : 不过两个都挺糟的。但在我——

lines.en: : Stop groping yourself. It’s getting distracting.
lines.zh: : 别再摸你自己了。看得我心烦。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade40
: But until I’m “enough” for you, there’s not really anything I can do about that.
lines.zh: : 但在我对你来说“够”之前，这事我实在无能为力。

lines.en: : You were right. I’m not as okay with sharing you as I thought I was. I was just telling myself that.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我没自己以为的那么能接受分享你。我之前只是在骗自己。

lines.en: : It’s...really surprising to have to hear you admit that here and now of all times and places.
lines.zh: : 真是没想到，居然会在这里、在这个时候听到你承认这个。

lines.en: : I’m surprised too. None of this would have happened if you didn’t show up at my club today. Way to go and ruin my life, Sensei. You know I have feelings now.
lines.zh: : 我也很意外。要是你今天没出现在我的社团，这一切都不会发生。干得漂亮，把我的生活毁了，老师。你现在知道我有感情了。

lines.en: : I’ve always known that, Kirin. But, just to set the record straight, you’re the one who’s ruining {i}my{/i} life now.
lines.zh: : 我一直都知道，Kirin。不过，把话说清楚，现在在毁掉{i}我{/i}生活的人是你。

lines.en: : I’m not at all surprised to hear that, but please tell me why.
lines.zh: : 听到这个我一点也不意外，但请告诉我为什么。

lines.en: : It’s just going to be a lot harder to hurt your feelings now that you’re acknowledging them.
lines.zh: : 只是因为，既然你现在肯承认自己的感情，我要伤你的心就难得多了。

lines.en: : Is running away still on the table?
lines.zh: : 逃跑还算是选项吗？

lines.en: : It never was.
lines.zh: : 从来都不是。

lines.en: : {i}Can{/i} it be on the table? Because starting over as a brand new person sounds like...the ultimate blessing right now.
lines.zh: : {i}能{/i}把它当成一个选项吗？因为作为一个全新的人重新开始，听起来就像……此刻最大的恩赐。

lines.en: : Especially since I have no clue how I’d ever face Noriko if I ascended from the sex-friend category into...whatever category she’s in.
lines.zh: : 尤其是，要是我从“炮友”这一档升到……她所在的那一档，我根本不知道该怎么面对 Noriko。

lines.en: : Let’s...go on a few more dates first before we start categorizing what we are now.
lines.zh: : 我们……先多约几次会，再开始给我们现在的关系分类吧。

lines.en: scene kirinarcade41
: Dates?...
: Was this a date?
lines.zh: : 这算是约会吗？

lines.en: : I...think so?
lines.zh: : 我……觉得算？

lines.en: scene kirinarcade42
: What the fuck? I didn’t even get to dress up for it.
lines.zh: : 什么鬼？我都没为它好好打扮。

lines.en: : Now we have to go on another one. It’s literally the only option.
lines.zh: : 那我们必须再约一次。这真的是唯一的选择。

lines.en: : Well...what are you doing tomorrow night?
lines.zh: : 那么……你明天晚上有空吗？

lines.en: scene kirinarcade43
: Heh...
scene black
: Sounds like I’m getting dressed up...
lines.zh: : 看来我得好好打扮一下了……

lines.en: $ kirinspecial45p1 = True
$ kirin_love += 1
{i}Kirin’s affection has increased to [kirin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Kirin 的好感度提升到了 [kirin_love]!{/i}

lines.en: scene bedroom_night
I make it back to my room after another eventful day.
lines.zh: 又经历了风波不断的一天后，我回到了自己的房间。

lines.en: And I worry about how much my life is about to change.
lines.zh: 我担心我的生活即将发生多大的变化。

lines.en: That seems to be all that’s happening lately.
lines.zh: 这似乎是最近唯一在发生的事。

show thursday
